name: (Melfesh Monster) Swell

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

text:
Frequency once per hour

---

Effect The Melfesh Monster inflates with gas for 1 minute. It grows to Huge size, and its reach increases to 15 feet. It also gains 12 temporary Hit Points, resistance 5 to bludgeoning, and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls, but it's Clumsy 1. When the Melfesh Monster takes damage while swollen, all creatures within 15 feet inhale spores that remain in their body for 1 minute. This ability replaces terrorspores and Spore Cloud.

Effect: Swell
